name: Smith Machine Sprinter Lunge
steps: Set the bar across your upper back and stand with one foot forward and the rear heel raised.
Release the hooks and bend both knees, leaning forward slightly from your hips over the planted front foot.
Push through the front foot to rise, extending your rear leg behind you as it leaves the floor.
Return the rear toes to the floor and lower into the lunge, then rerack before switching sides.
tips: Keep your feet spaced hip-width side to side for stable lateral balance.
Ensure your front knee tracks cleanly over your toes rather than collapsing inward.
